To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the best performance is achieved by utilizing word embedding vectors from large and popular collections; (2) the best performance on sentiment polarity is achieved by combining convolution layers of words and bigrams and max pooling of regions of varying sizes; and (3) the best performance of the derived architecture is achieved by training on a medium sized data set that has been properly labeled.
1. Crowdsourcing can be an effective and efficient way to create medium sized and emotion tagged datasets for sentiment polarity analysis.

1) social tags are effective and can be used to label data for emotion analysis; 2) word embedding models are not always effective and the best results are achieved with models trained on data that are related to the data used for training the model; 3) a convolutional architecture that uses convolutions of words and bigrams and max pooling of regions is effective and achieves state-of-the-art results on sentiment analysis of movie, product and business reviews.
In summary, our research is concerned with
deep learning architectures and word embeddings for the problem of sentiment polarity analysis.
the design and development of deep neural networks architectures for text polarity analysis.
the design and implementation of deep learning architectures for sentiment analysis of text.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
word embeddings from large and popular collections of texts are more effective than embeddings created from smaller data sets.
word embedding vectors are best created from the same data that the network will use for training.
the proposed architecture achieves the best results in the field of sentiment analysis and text mining, while it is generic and can be applied to various domains.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed and validated a generic deep neural network architecture for sentiment polarity analysis of texts that is effective and can be applied to various text types.
the use of deep neural network on text polarity analysis can be very successful if the right data sets, embedding vectors and architectures are selected.
deep learning techniques are highly promising on sentiment polarity analysis and can achieve state of the art performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to create effective deep neural network architectures for sentiment polarity analysis of texts, with minimal design effort and with the use of medium sized data sets.
neural networks can achieve state-of-the-art performance in text sentiment analysis, if the right architecture is used, the right word embeddings are chosen and the data set is big enough.
it is possible to achieve competitive sentiment polarity analysis results using deep neural networks with minimal design and engineering effort.
